observations: Two small white desktop speakers on a wooden surface.
Brand mark “logi” visible on photo 0/1 (left speaker).
Right speaker has a visible blue LED and a volume/controls area on photo 1.
Close-up label on photo 2 shows: “2207 Right Speaker Sound Wall Bluetooth” and “Models: 001108”.
Photo 2 label also shows power/input info: “Input 6V == 1.5A” and regulatory markings (FCC/IC).

claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound.
claims.evidence: No audio test/video or functional check shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices for good...
claims.evidence: No pairing/connection screen, cable/ports photo, or device compatibility proof shown.

risks.risk: Not fully working (one speaker dead, distortion, or Bluetooth not pairing). Photos only show appearance/LED, not sound quality or connectivity.
risks.proof: Short video of both speakers playing the same audio track (volume up/down) and a Bluetooth pairing screen/phone connected confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair or one side not working).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables or wrong power adapter (label indicates 6V input; seller photos don’t show charger/adapter).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included: power adapter/charging cable, any AUX/USB cable, and the exact ports on the speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/unknown accessories (buyer may need to source adapter/cables).

risks.risk: Model mismatch (photo 2 is specifically “Right Speaker”; left speaker model/label not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up label photo of the left speaker showing the same model/series.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it may be incomplete/mismatched (worst case: not a matched pair).

risks.risk: Bluetooth range/latency issues or battery/charging issue (if it’s rechargeable). Photos don’t confirm power source type beyond label input.
risks.proof: Video showing Bluetooth connection distance test (e.g., phone across the room) and whether it stays connected.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as wired/limited performance only (worst case: Bluetooth unreliable).

proof_requests: Video/audio test: both speakers playing the same track with volume control shown.
Bluetooth proof: phone/laptop pairing screen and confirmation that audio is coming through both speakers.
Photo of included items: the exact 6V adapter/charging cable and any AUX/connection cable.
Close-up label of the left speaker (to confirm it matches the right speaker model).
response.reason: The photos identify the speakers as Logitech/Logi “2207” (Models: 001108) but do not prove they work properly or that Bluetooth/device pairing works; key risks (sound quality, connectivity, missing accessories, matched pair) need quick functional proof before pricing confidently.
